correctness.rationale: Each radius-one output ball is regenerated from source words; the confusability graph encodes precisely overlapping outputs. Independent-set inclusion/exclusion recurrence is exhaustive on every finite induced graph, proving maxima and optimizer counts. All 40 layers include explicit attaining independent sets plus exactly checked nonnegative primal and dual rational shadow weights with identical totals. Reversal fixed points are exhaustively counted; an independent integer-programming reconstruction agreed. The statements are finite \(1\le n\le10\) only.

value.rationale: Zero-error one-swap correction on the standard forbidden-11 modulation language is a natural channel design invariant. The first nonintegrality at length seven followed by exact equality at eight is a meaningful boundary for the standard fractional shadow relaxation; the exhaustive equality and reversal census gives further structural information. The limited finite range is explicit and no unsupported asymptotic gain is claimed.
